title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vigneshwaran exploits Vennila's hidden secrets to extort money from her. At the same time, Karthi informs Sivagami that Anbu's love for Kanmani has blossomed again.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma's memories reveal that Paraman is Rishi's long-lost brother. Meanwhile, Ilamathi fails to convince Paraman that Kalamma raised him for selfish reasons.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel, Vadivu and Maari invite Pandian's family to Kumar's wedding. Later, Saravanan reluctantly agrees to marry Arasi to Kumar after his refusal to call off the wedding.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Vannathi Grows Fond of the Doctor
description: Vannathi enjoys a heartfelt conversation with the doctor. Nila grows suspicious when Chozhan avoids her calls and begins to believe Pandian is involved and is hiding something.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Manoj agrees to help Rohini financially but binds her with a stern warning never to leave him. Meanwhile, Muthu credits Swetha for playing a key role in his and Meena's success.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Celebrating S. Janaki's legacy, the stage comes alive with emotional performances and a breathtaking medley. Heartfelt memories and tributes make the celebration even more special.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: Rakshan unveils the Heritage theme as teams select Comalis. Ma Ka Pa and Ramar bring non-stop laughs before a tough flour-sieving advantage challenge tests everyone!
